# Quantum Bandit Certification

Question: Can collective quantum measurements improve uniform certification of a known reference state against all fixed IID sources above a reward threshold?

Result: At fixed finite dimension and an interior threshold above the null mean, every reference state has the classical spectral KL exponent at each fixed Type-I tolerance in (0,1), with a strong converse. Every finite measurement-block game has the same value. Unrestricted adaptive-memory bandit regret is not solved.

Keep these distinctions: known-null certification versus unknown-arm learning; shared-phase mixtures of IID alternatives versus per-copy drift; max-min common measurement versus min-max pairwise measurement; a leading error exponent versus equal finite-sample risks. Read proof qualifiers before transferring a theorem to another model.
